decks.notes: This deck focuses on using ramp spells and powerful Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans to ramp up mana production, the goal is to cast devastating Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker ahead of schedule. Additionally, control elements such as Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble help clear the opponent's board while protecting our own, allowing for a patient and strategic approach to victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temples and Talismans, while also using cards like Through the Breach to cheat out powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. The main goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command, while also using cards like Ugin's Labyrinth to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Cavern of Souls and Boseiju helps to protect your creatures and spells from counterspells, making it difficult for your opponent to deal with your threats.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to flood the board with aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor, Guide of Souls, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the opponent's board. The deck also utilizes powerful enchantments like The One Ring and Static Prison to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional versatility and consistency to the deck. Lastly, the inclusion of cards like Ocelot Pride and Goblin Bombardment offer additional sources of damage and utility.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm opponents. With cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Lightning Bolt for additional damage, combined with control elements like Static Prison and Skyclave Apparition, this deck aims to maintain board control while constantly applying pressure. The inclusion of Aether Hub and Arena of Glory provide additional mana sources and advantage, making this deck a formidable force in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes powerful creatures such as Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Amped Raptor for additional pressure. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and The One Ring provide extra reach and versatility in dealing with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game with a relentless offensive strategy.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption while establishing a board presence with creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. The deck aims to control the game tempo, efficiently removing threats and countering spells until it can secure a win condition. By utilizing a mix of control elements and creatures, the deck seeks to outvalue the opponent and maintain control of the game until victory is achieved. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to its spells.

The concept of this deck is to control the game through ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl, while disrupting opponents with cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of cards like Trinisphere and The One Ring help to slow down opponents, giving the deck time to set up its win condition. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game state and playing large threats to close out the game.

The deck revolves around utilizing ramp spells and Eldrazi creatures to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. By utilizing cards like Eldrazi Temple, Ugin's Labyrinth, and Emrakul, the Promised End, the deck can quickly ramp into its big creatures while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of control spells like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return helps to further control the board and deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent with its powerful Eldrazi creatures and control elements.

This deck focuses on using a variety of spells and abilities to combo off without relying on lands. The key strategy involves using cards like Thunderstrap Trainer and Waterlogged Teachings to control the opponent while setting up the combo pieces such as Hydroelectric Specimen and Fallaji Archaeologist. Tameshi, Reality Architect and Sea Gate Restoration provide additional support in digging for combo pieces, while cards like Pact of Negation and Suppression Ray protect the combo from disruption. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and use Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to the opponent in a single turn.

This deck aims to control the board and ramp up to powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and World Breaker. It utilizes cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also benefitting from cards that help ramp up mana like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple. The deck also includes cards like Kozilek's Return for removal and protection. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and control the game until you can unleash the Eldrazi to dominate the battlefield.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells, supported by powerful enchantments such as Blood Moon and Arena of Glory. The deck aims to finish the game quickly by dealing damage efficiently and controlling the board with cards like Galvanic Discharge and Static Prison. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional threats, while The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury can quickly close out games with their powerful abilities.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt to finish off opponents. The deck also includes cards like Static Prison to control the board and Arena of Glory to give your creatures an advantage in combat. Overall, the focus is on building a fast and powerful board presence to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggression and creature synergy, aiming to quickly overrun the opponent with a mix of powerful creatures and burn spells. The deck includes versatile cards like Lightning Bolt and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with more powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. By combining fast creatures with burn spells and creature pumps, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game and maintain that pressure until victory is achieved.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By maintaining a strong board presence and utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment to control the battlefield, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and high-impact creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury adds a versatile element to the deck, allowing for multiple avenues to victory. With a balance of aggression and control, this Boros Aggro deck aims to establish dominance early and close out games swiftly.

This Aggro Jund deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of creatures and spells to pressure the opponent quickly and aggressively. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Nethergoyf to quickly close out the game. The inclusion of Traverse the Ulvenwald helps find key creatures or lands, while Omnivorous Flytrap and Detective's Phoenix provide additional threats. The deck aims to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Malevolent Rumble.

The deck focuses on control and using powerful spells and abilities to protect and utilize The One Ring artifact to dominate the game. It includes cards like Force of Negation, Supreme Verdict, and Counterspell to control the opponent's plays, while also using cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Teferi, Time Raveler to gain advantage and tempo. The deck seeks to establish board control and outvalue the opponent through efficient removal and card advantage, ultimately winning the game using The One Ring as a powerful finisher.
